evidence.ref: E4-rest: rust/bc2-levelwrite/examples/rush_facts.rs on 31 Rush and Squad Rush levels, 2026-11-22: 30 levels with one base counter per stage and the exact chain (87 stages), BaseCount equal on 30 of 30; base counters' `OnTrigger` CapturePoint `Enable` of the next stage's 54 of 57 middle stages, CombatArea `Enable` 43, `Disable` of its own 36 (0 on the last); 78 later stages' other counters enabled from the start, 3 not; `ons_mp_005gr` (the Onslaught install's) has no defenders' life counter

E4-rest sweep, 2026-11-22: on all 30 levels a stage added after the last plays last with its copies as the last stage's objects (72 - 323 copies, 7 - 62 connections added) and, taken out again, gives back every instance and stage state; each of the 87 stages taken out leaves the others in their order and states but one hold-back combat area on nam_mp_002r

rules.title: A stage is wired to the next by its base counter

evidence.ref: E4-rest2 sweep, 2026-11-27: on all 30 Rush and Squad Rush levels a stage inserted between every two stages (57 insertions, 72 - 900 copies and 15 - 238 connections a level): each plays between the two with every old stage as before and, taken out again, gives back every instance, stage state and connection; 42 connections had no counterpart to split (0 - 5 a level); MP_006's dormant sixth forward base is not copied with its last stage; Port Valdez (mp_012gr) with a stage inserted after the first built in 28 - 37 s and held by `export::check`

rules.title: A stage inserted between two splits the wiring between them
